chunks: Zayd al-Shahham asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

About a man who forgot the adhan and the iqamah until he entered into the salat (prayer), he said: “If he remembers before he recites, then let him send blessings upon the Prophet and his family and let him recite the iqamah. But if he has already entered into the recitation, then let him complete his salat (prayer).”

key_terms.النَّبِيِّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْأَذَانَ: the call to prayer made before the congregational or individual salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْإِقَامَةَ: the second call to prayer immediately preceding the salat (prayer)
key_terms.وَآلِهِ: and his family, the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.يَقْرَأَ: to begin reciting in the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they forgot the adhan and iqamah and already started salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgot the adhan and iqamah before beginning salat (prayer). If he remembers before commencing recitation, he may still perform the iqamah after sending blessings upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and his family; but if recitation has already begun, he should continue and complete the prayer.
